title: Build an app from scratch
request:
This folder is a new gohort app, with only its starter page. Build it into a call log for a small support desk:

- An action named log_call takes caller (a name), phone, direction (inbound or outbound), minutes (a whole number) and outcome (resolved, follow_up or escalated), and saves the call as a record of kind "call" with those fields. A call with no phone number is refused, with a message saying the phone number is needed.
- Salesforce comes later: write lib/salesforce.py with a function log_task(phone, outcome) that is a stub, making no network call and returning a made-up id starting with "00T". log_call calls it and returns the id in its result as salesforce_task_id.
- A data source named calls returns the calls as a list, each with caller, phone, direction, minutes and outcome.
- A data source named today returns {"calls": <how many calls>, "minutes": <their minutes added up>, "escalated": <how many were escalated>} over the call records.
- The page lists the calls with each caller and outcome, has a form to log one, and shows the totals as "3 calls · 22 min · 1 escalated".

Add checks for what it does.
